sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To provide a basic understanding of the principles of Classical Mechanics and their application to simple dynamical systems.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Particles and particle systems. B. Fixed axis rotations. C. Rigid bodies (including geophysical applications such as the precession of the axis of rotation of the earth). D. The two-body problem (the motion of planets, comets, and satellites).
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered by a combination of formal lectures and tutorials.
